skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies in a column with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 150% ATK + 45% Max HP as DMG. Immediately triggers [Breakthrough], removing 1 instance of [Specialized Unyielding] from affected enemies.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Before attacking, increases own CRIT Rate by 30%. Attacks all enemies in a column with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 180% ATK + 54% Max HP as DMG. Immediately triggers [Breakthrough], removing 1 instance of [Specialized Unyielding] from affected enemies.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, permanently increases own Max HP by 100% and enters battle at full HP. Before each new round begins, restores 50% Max HP. Before any character takes action, removes [Stun] from 1 ally, up to 2 times per round.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, permanently increases own Max HP by 100% and enters battle at full HP. Before each new round begins, restores 70% Max HP. Before any character takes action, removes [Stun] from 1 ally, up to 2 times per round.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, permanently increases own Max HP by 100% and enters battle at full HP. Before each new round begins, restores 90% Max HP. Before any character takes action, removes [Stun] from 1 ally, up to 3 times per round.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, summons 1 [Three-legged Crow]. The Crow inherits HP equal to 400% of Gouketsu’s initial Max HP and absorbs 85% of the DMG that Gouketsu and allies in the same row would receive. When the [Three-legged Crow] is defeated, it explodes and deals additional DMG equal to 30% of its Max HP to 3 random enemies, prioritizing enemies affected by [Specialized Unyielding]. It also reduces the remaining action count of enemies’ [Specialized Unyielding] by 2.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, summons 2 [Three-legged Crow]. Each Crow inherits HP equal to 400% of Gouketsu’s initial Max HP and absorbs 85% of the DMG received by its protected row. The second Crow protects the other row. When a [Three-legged Crow] is defeated, it explodes and deals additional DMG equal to 30% of its Max HP to 3 random enemies, prioritizing enemies affected by [Specialized Unyielding]. It also reduces the remaining action count of enemies’ [Specialized Unyielding] by 2.

effects.desc: Removes 1 instance of [Specialized Unyielding] from the affected target.
